title: Bridging the AI Accessibility Gap: An Offline Educational Chatbot System for Underserved Regions

contributions.purpose: 离线、聚焦教育的轻量对话系统
contributions.mechanism: DistilBERT + 教育专用微调,4GB 内存约束内运行
contributions.evaluation: 教育查询准确率 92.4%,平均响应 445ms,内存 3.8GB(单基线对比)
contributions.domain: 教育 AI / 边缘部署
contributions.source_quote: We develop a novel architecture combining DistilBERT with educational-specific fine-tuning, achieving 92.4% educational accuracy while operating within 4GB memory constraints.

contributions.purpose: 将开放教育资源与 AI 融合
contributions.mechanism: OER(Kolibri/OpenStax/Khan Academy)内容预处理为课程对齐训练数据
contributions.evaluation: 框架性描述,无独立数字
contributions.source_quote: We establish a framework for integrating Open Educational Resources with AI systems, enabling curriculum-aligned responses without internet dependency.

contributions.purpose: 验证大规模离线部署可行性
contributions.mechanism: 跨机构部署测试并统计用户与成功率
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate successful large-scale deployment across 51 institutions in diverse settings, serving over 9,700 users with 94% technical success rate.

notes: desk-reject。强数据红旗/疑似虚构:匿名投稿却声称已在 51 家机构(含 '军事基地、监狱')实地部署、6 个月服务 9,724 用户,此类大规模真实部署对匿名提交高度不可核验;AI 披露自承 ~35% AI 贡献且明列 'synthetic data generation'(合成数据生成),部署数据来源可疑。Table 1 仅单行基线对比,缺乏对照严谨性。占位式署名(Anonymous)。据 abstract+conclusion 归纳 3 条声明贡献。
